question: A point object is placed $20\text{ cm}$ in front of a spherical glass surface. Light travels from air into glass of refractive index $1.5$. If the radius of curvature of the surface is $10\text{ cm}$, find the image position.

options.A: Using $\dfrac{1.5}{v}-\dfrac{1}{-20}=\dfrac{1.5-1}{10}$ gives $\dfrac{1.5}{v}+\dfrac{1}{20}=\dfrac{1}{20}$, so $\dfrac{1.5}{v}=0$ and $v=\infty$. The refracted rays are parallel.
